findings.title: Empty-platforms manifest gets published
findings.problem: When no release asset matches any platform pattern (for example an installer was renamed), buildManifest returns platforms: {} and the script writes and exits 0. The workflow step then uploads it and the next step publishes the release.
findings.impact: A published release whose manifest has no platforms makes every client fail with 'No installer available for platform', so updates silently stop. This contradicts the acceptance that a release carries every shipped platform's installer URL. Reachability of a rename was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: After buildManifest, if Object.keys(manifest.platforms).length === 0, print an error and process.exit(1) so the workflow fails before publishing. Keep the check platform-agnostic.
